risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company faces increased risk of cyberattacks amplified by AI tools, potentially leading to financial losses, reputational damage, and costly litigation

ai_positioning.summary: BDC mentions artificial intelligence in its 10-K filing in connection with cybersecurity risks. AI is cited as a tool potentially enhancing cyberattack capabilities (hacking, malware, phishing), with no positive AI implementation strategy identified.
evidence: Computer hacking, malware, phishing, and spamming attacks... more recently enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools
